Title: Ishaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ishaan - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Neeta - 38 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Nitin - 46 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
4. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "Ishaan, what's the plan today?"

[Ishaan slips and falls.]

Ishaan: "Mom, look at this."

[Ishaan trips over a stone.]

Ishaan: "And then?"

[Ishaan hurts his knee.]

Ishaan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Ishaan helps Mother get up.]

Neeta: "That's easy."

[Ishaan sneezes loudly.]

Ishaan: "How beautiful!"

[Ishaan coughs.]

Neeta: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Ishaan stands in the park. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "Ishaan, look over here."

[Ishaan catches the ball.]

Ishaan: "Okay, Mom."

[Ishaan kicks the football hard.]

Ishaan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Ishaan plays cricket in the park.]

Ishaan: "I knew it!"

[Ishaan goes down the slide.]

Neeta: "Careful!"

[Ishaan plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Ishaan (softly): "Careful!"

[Ishaan plays with his dog.]

Ishaan: "Okay, Mom."

[Ishaan feeds the birds.]

Ishaan: "What happened?"

Scene 3: The main road - Day

[Ishaan stands on the road. Neeta and Nitin stand near him.]

Neeta: "What a nice place."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Ishaan sits in the back seat.]

Neeta: "That's great!"

[Ishaan sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Ishaan: "Yes, all right."

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Ishaan in the back.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 4: The road - Day

[Ishaan stands by the road. Neeta and Nitin stand near him.]

Nitin: "What a nice place."

[Father rides the bicycle with Ishaan sitting on the carrier behind him.]

Neeta: "What a day to remember!"
